reviews.text: Staffs are very friendly and helpful. Shop is also well organized. Great spot to shop for furkids!
I’ve visited this shop twice and it offers a wide range of pet fashion options.

Great appreciation to the staff at this pet paradise for the wonderful recommendation! 🐶

I visited so many stores trying to find a comfortable pillow for my dog, and finally, one of the staff members here recommended this cooling pillow from their warehouse.

Just look at how much my dog ​​loves this new little companion! 🥰🐾💤

Thank you so much to the staff at this pet paradise for the wonderful recommendation! 🐶❤️

Look!

Excellent choice, they have pet puppets to try out your pets sizing

We came across Pet Paradise Shibuya while looking for a raincoat for our dog. I picked a size that I was pretty sure would fit her, but the lady at the register tried it on a toy dog and told us it would be too small. I trusted her advice and didn’t buy the raincoat.

Instead, we bought a backpack leash. Again, I chose the size I thought would fit, but she told us it was too small and recommended a bigger one. When we got home and tried it on our dog, it was actually too big. The backpack keeps turning to the side whenever she walks.

I wish I had trusted my own judgment since I know my dog’s size better. My advice is not to rely only on the toy dog for sizing because every dog is built differently. I also wish we had bought that raincoat!
Courteous and accommodating staff, good cute options for pets but it can be pricey

I think the pet paradise people in Shibuya are really nice and they help me a lot and they spend time looking for what I need and I appreciate that. When I say my dog is the size they say this is the section for your fat dog and I say thank you.
I bought this super cute little kimono for my maltese 😍 they were very kind and helped me with the measurements I took🙇🏻‍♀️ + big choice of dog and cat snacks …
It’s good that it’s always the same.
The shop staff seemed very willing to answer product-related questions. A positive shopping experience.
A store full of items for your pet. Clothes and costumes for dogs and cats.
These pet clothes are adorable, though a bit pricey, but they have a lot of exquisite designs.

I bought this as a gift for my friend’s children, but unfortunately the size was a bit small. I went back the next day to exchange it, but was told it was a no refund / no exchange policy.
However, after explaining the situation, they kindly made an exception and allowed me to exchange the size.
I truly appreciate it—thank you so much!
Significantly worse selection than in other cities

I had a very unpleasant experience at Pet Paradise in Shibuya.

The blonde staff member had a terrible attitude; when I politely asked about the size of the product, she immediately showed signs of irritation.

Furthermore, at checkout, she roughly snatched my smartphone and placed it on the cash register.

I have never encountered such problems at other branches.

Such rude treatment of tourists is unacceptable.

I hope that the staff's customer service training will be thoroughly strengthened.

At checkout, she even roughly snatched my phone and placed it on the cash register.

I have never encountered such problems at other branches.

Lawless and unforgiving, like a tourist.
Desired store staff will enhance their abilities and train their employees in service.
It's located a few doors down an alley off the main street, so you can't get there by taxi; you'll have to walk!
As a pet parent, its a must visit shop in Tokyo if you are on a trip to Japan. But beware your wallet is going to get empty shortly as it has so many products and wonderful staff.
It’s tax-free and really great. There are a lot of pretty clothes in sizes that are hard to find in Korea, so I always make sure to visit when I go to Tokyo.
You'll find beautiful things, good materials, and the prices are great too.

Bought this jerky chicken snacks for my dogs and they loved it!
These are very soft and are probably tasty, because now my dogs follow me for more snacks hahaha

Rude staff. She snatched an outfit my mom was trying to size for her dog out of her hands.

What a rude staff member. She snatched an outfit my mom was trying to size for her dog out of her hands.
There were so many cute and pretty things! But they were also expensive ㅠㅠ

I really like the quality of the products.

The quality of the products is excellent, and even though my Japanese is poor, the staff were very helpful. The kimonos are also very cute.

Thank you very much.
The stuffs are just overpriced
Situated on B1.  If you can’t find it elsewhere they’ll have it here!
Came here twice in the last couple of years.  Variety of dog clothes with great quality.
I've been to the Harajuku and Shinjuku branches, Shibuya has the most items.

Great spot for dog parents in Tokyo! If you have a big pup (ours is a 55-lb fur baby 🐾), this store is a must-visit! They have adorable winter jackets, outfits, tons of toys, and treats to bring back for your dog. I visited several pet store throughout Tokyo, and this one definitely had the best variety and selection. Highly recommend for anyone traveling with or shopping for their pup!
My favourite pet accessories shop in Tokyo, staff is friendly and accommodating.
Staff very helpful and patient!
There isn't as much variety in products as I expected, and the prices are higher than I thought.
This store has the most adorable pet clothes ever! A bit pricey but the quality is totally worth it ! I would definitely come back to buy more cute stuff 🐶🎀💝 …
Thank you for the haircut! The dog hairspray worked really well! Thank you so much, Saku-Vulve!

This pet store isn't very big, but it has a rich variety of items. Since there are quite a lot of people in Tokyo who keep small dogs, if you have a small breed, there are plenty of things you can buy here. However, we have a large dog at home, so in the end, I picked out some pet snacks—both for cats and dogs. Overall, I was quite satisfied. Well, if you need supplies for large dogs, it might be better to go to a bigger store; places like the one in Odaiba probably have a wider selection.
She has the most beautiful clothes for dogs that you could ever find.
Really kind staff who are eager to help you proactively!
Great buying for our pet. Perfect location and products that I have never seen anywhere.
Cute little store to spoil your fluffy best friend. Great customer service :)
They had a lot of cute clothes, which was a different style from what I was looking for. It might be perfect for people who like Snoopy or similar things.
Beautiful shop with very good quality of clothes for my cute dogs!!!

I visited Shibuya around October 15. I was on my way back from the Pokémon center when I saw this nice shop. I really enjoyed the shop! They have so many nice things for dogs! 🐕 The girl who was working that day,Thank you so much for helping me find the right size for my dog..
she had this size guide card and even looked with me. Her English was also decent so it was fine with communication.

Thank u Japan for giving me nice things to remember and even enjoy right now when I’m home!!

Arigatō gozaimashita from the Netherlands 🇳🇱

There was no changing table for dogs to try on the clothes.
I was literally struggling so I put a small shopping bag (a Pet Paradise shopping bag!) at the cashier, a staff told the other staff who was helping me to use the floor.
Mind you, the place was empty. It wasn’t like there was a queue to make payment etc.

Decided against making the purchase since service was bad.

The staff who helped me was really friendly and tried as much as she could to help with trying on the top.

Most pet paradise (if not all) has a changing table for dogs. The last thing I’d expect from such a big name such as Pet Paradise, is to ask the customer to try on the clothes on their pets on the floor.

Also, I’m not sure if I heard right.
But after my first question about the difference in material, I heard them saying“from China”.
I am not from China but also not sure how it would have made a difference where I am from.
Only pointing this out because the initial attitude from the unfriendly staff was fine up until I heard “from China”.

There are many pet accessories, but mostly for small dogs. Medium and large sizes are almost nonexistent. But the designs they do have are very cute. We bought several Snoopy collars and a Snoopy outfit for a beagle.
Cute 😍 …

There are lots of cute clothes~! Prices are generally around 5,000-6,000 yen. I had a rough idea of ​​the price range so I bought them~ And I saw a lot of them for 10,000 yen at other pet shops in Nakameguroㅎㅎㅎㅎ So I bought them without hesitation~! The staff was also kind and helped me compare sizes with a puppy doll. Please refer to the tag for detailed sizes~
THE BEST place to buy things for pets! 💕 …

The foreign staff here were super friendly!! They explained everything so well that I wanted to buy a lot of things, but the prices were just too high ㅠㅠㅠㅠ Almost one piece of clothing costs 40,000-50,000 won...🥲 …
Despite the numerous shortcomings on our end, they handled the return process with exceptional courtesy.
cute

They have a wide selection of lovely costumes and toys. 
When I asked about something I didn't understand, the staff were happy to explain in detail, so I was able to shop with peace of mind.
The clothes are adorable, the styles are plentiful, and the shop staff are very nice and helpful, assisting with size confirmation. I've shopped there several times already.
